title: Gifts for Him Under $50 (He'll Actually Use)
desc: Useful, thoughtful gifts for him under $50: boyfriend, husband, dad and brother gift ideas for the griller, the gadget guy and the guy who has everything.
lede: Useful gifts for the boyfriend, husband, dad or brother who says he doesn't want anything. Every pick here is usually under $50.
card: Grilling, tech, everyday carry and cozy picks for the guy who says he doesn't want anything.

sections.name: For the grill guy
sections.note: Practical upgrades he'll use every weekend.

items.name: Instant-read meat thermometer
items.why: Reads in about 2 to 3 seconds, so no more cutting into the steak to check. The most-used gift a griller can get, and it costs less than dinner out.

items.name: Heavy-duty BBQ tool set
items.search: heavy duty stainless steel BBQ grill tool set with case
items.why: Stainless spatula, tongs and fork in a carry case. Looks great unwrapped and replaces the mismatched tools he's been using for years.

items.name: Wireless meat probe (budget pick)
items.why: Leave it in the meat and check the temperature from his phone. Feels like a splurge gift without the splurge price.

sections.name: For his everyday carry
sections.note: Small things he'll use every single day.

items.name: Slim RFID leather wallet
items.search: RUNBOX slim RFID leather bifold wallet men
items.why: Trades the overstuffed wallet for something slim that still holds cards and cash. A classic gift that never misses.

items.name: Ratchet leather belt
items.search: mens leather ratchet belt no holes
items.why: No holes, so it adjusts to a perfect fit. Clean buckle that works with jeans or a suit.

items.name: Magnetic tool wristband
items.search: magnetic wristband for holding screws tools
items.why: Holds screws, nails and bits on his wrist while he works. Weirdly fun to give, and every DIY guy ends up using it.

sections.name: For the tech guy
sections.note: Gadgets that feel more expensive than they are.

items.name: Wood phone docking station
items.search: wood phone docking station nightstand organizer men
items.why: Keeps his phone, keys, wallet and watch in one place on the nightstand. Looks handsome and can be personalized.

items.name: Solar power bank
items.why: Rugged backup battery for hikes, camping, travel or game day. One of those gifts he won't think about until it saves him.

items.name: Over-ear headphones
items.why: Comfortable wired headphones from a trusted audio brand, great for gaming, music or the office.

sections.name: For the guy who needs to relax

items.name: Shiatsu neck and back massager
items.search: shiatsu neck back massager pillow with heat
items.why: Heated massage pillow for his neck or lower back after work or the gym. Usually a hit with dads too.

items.name: Beard balm
items.why: Softens and tames the beard without feeling greasy. An easy add-on or stocking stuffer.

items.name: Moon lamp
items.why: A glowing, realistic moon for his desk or nightstand. Looks cool in a dorm, office or game room.

title: Stocking Stuffers Under $15 (That Won't End Up in a Drawer)
desc: Cheap stocking stuffer ideas under $15 for adults: cozy socks, lip balm, book lights, card games and small useful gifts for him, her and the whole family.
lede: Small, useful, actually-fun stocking stuffers for adults. Every pick here is usually under $15, and most are under $10.
card: Cozy socks, self-care minis, desk helpers and little games that won't end up in a drawer.

items.name: Chenille cozy socks with grips
items.search: womens chenille cozy fuzzy socks with grips
items.why: Plush, soft and grippy on the soles, so they double as house slippers. Nobody has ever been sad to get good socks.

items.name: Ribbed cuff beanie
items.why: A warm, simple beanie that goes with every coat. Easy to pick a color they'll wear all winter.

items.name: Funny food crew socks
items.why: Pizza, tacos or bacon on their feet. A goofy, cheap laugh that still gets worn.

sections.name: Little self-care
sections.note: Small treats that feel like a spa night.

items.name: Lip balm holiday minis
items.search: eos lip balm holiday gift set
items.why: A few mini lip balms in seasonal flavors. Fits perfectly in the toe of a stocking.

items.name: Cooling under-eye patches
items.why: A pack of cooling eye patches for puffy mornings. Feels fancy for the price.

items.name: Sheet mask variety pack
items.why: A handful of fun, fruity sheet masks for a cozy night in. Great for teens and adults.

sections.note: Useful things they'll reach for all year.

items.name: Clip-on book light
items.search: Glocusent clip on book light rechargeable
items.why: Rechargeable, warm-light reading lamp that clips onto any book. Perfect for the night reader in your life.

items.name: Weekly planner notepad
items.search: weekly planner notepad tear off undated
items.why: A tear-off weekly planner pad for the desk or fridge. Helps start the new year organized.

items.name: Password logbook
items.why: A little alphabetical book for logins. Sounds silly, but the person always resetting passwords will love it.

items.name: Mini multi-bit screwdriver
items.search: multi bit precision screwdriver set pocket
items.why: Pocket-size screwdriver with swappable bits for glasses, toys and electronics. A handy gift for anyone.

items.name: Dutch Blitz card game
items.why: Fast, loud and easy to learn. A family game night favorite that fits in a stocking.

items.name: Squishy stress ball
items.search: squishy stress ball gel for adults
items.why: Satisfying to squeeze during long work calls. A tiny desk toy adults secretly love.

items.name: Pickle birthday candles
items.why: Pickle-shaped candles for the pickle lover. Pure, cheap joy and a great gag gift.

title: White Elephant Gifts Under $25 That Everyone Will Want to Steal
desc: Funny and useful white elephant gift ideas under $25: mini waffle maker, tortilla blanket, candle warmer lamp, party card games and more gifts people actually fight over.
lede: The best white elephant gifts get a laugh when they're opened and get stolen twice before the game ends. Every pick here is usually under $25, and most are under $20.
card: Funny, useful and weirdly coveted picks that get stolen before the game is over.

sections.name: The ones that get stolen
sections.note: Useful enough that everyone secretly wants them.

items.name: Dash mini waffle maker
items.why: Tiny, cute and makes a waffle in minutes. A white elephant classic because it works for literally anyone.

items.name: Candle warmer lamp with timer
items.search: candle warmer lamp with timer dimmer
items.why: Melts a jar candle from the top so it smells great with no flame. Looks like a little desk lamp and feels way more expensive.

items.name: Electric beverage chiller
items.why: Chills coffee, wine or soda fast without watering it down. Coffee people fight over this one.

items.name: Rechargeable luggage scale
items.why: No more overweight bag fees. Small, useful and something nobody buys for themselves.

sections.name: Funny but actually good
sections.note: Gets the big laugh, then gets used.

items.name: Giant tortilla blanket
items.why: A soft round blanket printed like a flour tortilla. Everyone wants a photo wrapped up like a burrito.

items.name: Positive pickle squishy light
items.why: A smiling pickle night light. Ridiculous, sweet and a guaranteed steal.

items.name: Emoji desktop vacuum
items.search: mini desktop vacuum cleaner cordless cute
items.why: Sucks up crumbs and eraser bits from a desk or keyboard. Silly-looking, surprisingly handy.

items.name: Classic Magic 8 Ball
items.why: Retro fun for the office or game night. Ask it whether to steal or keep your gift.

items.name: Bad People party game

items.name: Tapple word game
items.why: Fast, loud, battery-free word game for all ages. Great for families and office parties alike.

items.name: Sushi Go Party card game
items.why: A cute, quick card game that adults and kids both get hooked on.

items.name: Cozy wearable blanket
items.search: wearable fleece blanket with sleeves adults

items.name: Scalp massager
